title: Multi-organ imaging genetics: towards an integrated view of brain, body and brain diseases
title_zh: 多器官成像遗传学：迈向脑、身体及脑部疾病的综合视角
abstract: Population-based cohorts that combine genetic data with whole-body multimodal imaging are transforming how we map the genetic architecture of the brain in its broader bodily context. Historically, imaging genetics has focused largely on single organs, especially the brain, with separate efforts targeting the heart, skeleton and other organs for systemic diseases, and limited integration across organ systems. Yet, strong brain–body interactions and the high multimorbidity of brain and systemic diseases highlight the need for a brain-centred multi-organ perspective. Here we introduce the emerging field of brain-focused multi-organ imaging genetics, outlining key data resources and interdisciplinary analytical frameworks for large-scale multi-organ genetic discovery and reviewing the genetic associations between brain diseases and imaging phenotypes across organ systems. We discuss how these advances support a whole-body integrated view of brain health and disease and how they are beginning to reshape clinical translation for neurological conditions. We outline a roadmap for agentic artificial intelligence co-scientists that work alongside human researchers throughout the scientific discovery process, arguing that such systems will be essential for achieving an integrated understanding of brain health and disease, both as tools for individual researchers and as a collaborative infrastructure for the whole field. This article provides an overview of brain-focused multi-organ imaging genetics, outlining key data resources and analytical frameworks and reviewing cross-organ genetic insights into brain diseases. The authors propose a roadmap for implementing agentic AI co-scientists as essential infrastructure for advancing an integrated, whole-body understanding of brain health and disease.
abstract_zh: 基于人群的队列，将遗传数据与全身多模态成像相结合，正在改变我们绘制在更广泛身体背景下大脑遗传图谱的方式。历史上，成像遗传学主要集中在单一器官，尤其是大脑，针对心脏、骨骼等器官的系统性疾病研究是分开进行的，不同器官系统之间的整合有限。然而，大脑与身体之间的强烈相互作用以及大脑疾病与系统性疾病的高合并症突显了对以大脑为中心的多器官视角的需求。本文介绍了脑聚焦多器官成像遗传学这一新兴领域，概述了关键数据资源和跨学科分析框架，用于大规模多器官基因发现，并综述了不同器官系统中大脑疾病与成像表型的遗传关联。我们讨论了这些进展如何支持大脑健康与疾病的全身整合视角，以及它们如何开始重塑神经系统疾病的临床转化。我们概述了在科学发现过程中与人类研究人员协作的代理人工智能协同科学家的路线图，论证此类系统对于实现大脑健康与疾病的整合理解至关重要，无论是作为个人研究人员的工具，还是作为整个领域的协同基础设施。本文概述了脑聚焦多器官成像遗传学，概述了关键数据资源和分析框架，并综述了跨器官对大脑疾病的遗传见解。作者提出了实施代理人工智能协同科学家的路线图，作为推进大脑健康与疾病整合理解的必要基础设施。
